Everything was explained to me so I truly understood what would happen, how much it would cost, How long it would take etc. there were no surprises and we are very happy with the result. I would highly recommend them

In our quest to select a solar system and supplier/installer, we quickly discovered that everyone has the "best" product and services over and above all the competition!  How on earth does one separate the "sheep" from the "goats"?For us, it came down to a few things.  Firstly the company we finally chose gave us a very comprehensive quote offering 6 different options, provided graphs and various other information on the expected performance of the systems quoted.  They also included easy to read general information on PV systems and information about the company itself.  The electrician who came to quote actually got up on our roof, took measurements and notes on the structure of the roof, position of fixings, etc. He also not only inspected the meter box, but also opened it up and inspected the wiring in the back of it.  We were given contact details of other customers who were happy to give the installers references and we were able to visit the electricians premises  to view the panels and inverters before sale. The other two companies who quoted did not provide any of these things in nearly as much detail and neither got up on the roof.The decision process was also made easier because we had done a lot of research beforehand - Finn's site was an invaluable source of very readable information.  Before anyone came to quote, we made up a questionnaire and asked each of the quoting people the same questions and wrote down their answers.  This made it easy to compare what each company was offering.When it came to decision time, for us there was a clear winner.  Here's hoping we got it right!
